description:
Decision gate: proceed only if review-minimize-superseded-probe-20261110 recorded GO. On NO-GO, drop this item with that evidence.
After Theseus posts a new verdict review on a PR, minimise the bot's earlier verdict reviews on that PR with GraphQL `minimizeComment(classifier: OUTDATED)`, so a long PR shows one open verdict and one-line stubs. Inline threads are not minimised (they carry open findings and disputes). Behind a consumer policy flag (e.g. `report.minimize_superseded: true|false`), default false; Theseus's own policy may enable it after the probe.
Guardrails: never minimise the newest verdict, a non-bot review, an owner/attester comment, or any inline thread; a GraphQL failure is logged and never changes the verdict, status or gate result (fail-soft for presentation only); edit detection (T6) is unchanged and must not fire on minimised reviews (regression test using the probe's recorded responses); requires only the App's existing pull-request write permission (confirm; if a new permission is needed, stop and ask the owner); no live model calls; Theseus merge rule plus independent review (touches review posting).
